title: Choose from patterns
summary: Erlang: Choose from patterns. Try yellow.
introduction: case compares a value with patterns. The first matching branch supplies the result.

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.

blocks.title: Choose from patterns
blocks.code:
-module(lesson).
-export([main/0]).
main() ->
    Light = green,
    Message = case Light of red -> "Stop"; green -> "Go"; _ -> "Wait" end,
    io:format("~s~n", [Message]).

blocks.text: The green branch matches, so Message becomes Go.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use semicolons between branches and end after the last branch.
